title: Recruiting Finlay

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: You could smell barbequed dermis all the way to the west pier. And it was meant to be my shift.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You could smell barbequed dermis all the way to the west pier. And it was meant to be my shift.

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: He’s fine, flame retardant frame you know? Couple coats of industrial dermis-paint and he’ll be lychee.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He’s fine, flame retardant frame you know? Couple coats of industrial dermis-paint and he’ll be lychee.

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: Yeah, if I hadn’t gotten wasted with a hottie from the Stacks yesterday I’d be charcoal, man. Hey, think that black-market seat warmer I installed had something to do with it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, if I hadn’t gotten wasted with a hottie from the Stacks yesterday I’d be charcoal, man. Hey, think that black-market seat warmer I installed had something to do with it?

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: Ohh shit, shoulda known better than to trust that guy selling parts outta his bathroom. Worth a try though.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ohh shit, shoulda known better than to trust that guy selling parts outta his bathroom. Worth a try though.

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: Yeah I've heard of it! I’ve been asking Delbert to let me join for TIME but man won't budge. Says the wait list's too long.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah I've heard of it! I’ve been asking Delbert to let me join for TIME but man won't budge. Says the wait list's too long.

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: For real? Shit yes! Count me IN. Tell Delbert that I thank him for the opportunity, he is not gonna regret having me around.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: For real? Shit yes! Count me IN. Tell Delbert that I thank him for the opportunity, he is not gonna regret having me around.

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: Huh. Shit, he thinks I'm a fuck up doesn't he?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Huh. Shit, he thinks I'm a fuck up doesn't he?

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: Figures. I keep trying but the harder I try the worse things get. I should just take off to the Wastes or something. No one to hurt there.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Figures. I keep trying but the harder I try the worse things get. I should just take off to the Wastes or something. No one to hurt there.

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: I'd probably find a way to piss them off too. Well, anyway, later.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'd probably find a way to piss them off too. Well, anyway, later.

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: Since I got shipped out here to the Rig. Rest of them out here are ok, but Delbert, that dude’s on another LEVEL. His poetry, man, blows my freaking mind.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Since I got shipped out here to the Rig. Rest of them out here are ok, but Delbert, that dude’s on another LEVEL. His poetry, man, blows my freaking mind.

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: Hey man, you hear about the driller’s cyberchair? It went loco and fried him alive!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey man, you hear about the driller’s cyberchair? It went loco and fried him alive!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Gnarly.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Gnarly.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Is he ok?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is he ok?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Lucky escape.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Lucky escape.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Right... I gotta go.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right... I gotta go.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Have you heard of O.R.S?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Have you heard of O.R.S?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: There isn't a waitlist.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There isn't a waitlist.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Well, I can get you in.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, I can get you in.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Well, I can get you in.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Well, I can get you in.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Probably.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Probably.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How long have you known Delbert?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How long have you known Delbert?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How long have you known Delbert?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How long have you known Delbert?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Only the giant mutant cockroaches.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Only the giant mutant cockroaches.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Look, I can probably get you into O.R.S.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, I can probably get you into O.R.S.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Look, I can probably get you into O.R.S.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Look, I can probably get you into O.R.S.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't think he feels the same.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't think he feels the same.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't think he feels the same.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't think he feels the same.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm sure he won't.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm sure he won't.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You did what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You did what?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe you should try a different approach.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe you should try a different approach.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Maybe you should try a different approach.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Maybe you should try a different approach.
